name: cc-setup-tooling
description: Eight skills that keep a Claude Code setup safe and tidy: review a third-party skill or plugin before installing it (skill-scan-gate, cc-plugin-lock and an offline inventory), lint SKILL.md front matter and fix its quoting, score descriptions against labelled prompts, estimate what a project loads on every turn, merge least-privilege permission rules and test them with claude-perm-sim, scaffold and test hooks with cc-hooks, find skills that collide or shadow each other, and find what breaks on other hosts and operating systems. Standard-library scripts, no network.
